sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog: 4.3.20: Clearer discount code feedback at checkout. When a code only works with certain delivery methods, customers now see a friendly note (it applies once they choose a delivery method) instead of a confusing error, and it updates automatically as they pick their shipping. Codes that don't apply now explain why (like a bottle minimum or a member-only code), right where the code is entered.
